transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with the weekly training review. We've got three mandatory training sessions to schedule over the next three workdays: forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher, and hazardous-materials handling refresher. Each needs a two-hour block. Before I sign the schedule, I need to hear from each of you. Let's go around the room -- training NCO, motor pool sergeant, then safety officer. Please give me your status updates on anything that affects training availability, facilities, or safety controls.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a scheduling constraint on the forklift-operator certification. The only currently certified forklift evaluator is available for the company session exactly Wednesday from 0900 to 1100. I confirmed the evaluator's duty roster this morning, but the roster change has not yet been added to the company training slide. This means the forklift certification block must be scheduled Wednesday 0900-1100.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a constraint on the motor pool training bay. The bay is occupied by a scheduled generator load-bank inspection from Tuesday 0800 through 1200. I received the maintenance booking from the shop supervisor, but it hasn't been entered on the training calendar yet. This means the generator-operator refresher can't be held Tuesday morning -- it has to be scheduled Tuesday from 1300 to 1500.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a safety constraint on the hazardous-materials handling refresher. The hazmat refresher requires a ventilation pause and a safety-monitoring team, and I confirmed today that both are available exactly Monday from 1000 to 1200. This requirement is still only in the safety office's working copy and hasn't been published yet, but it means the hazmat refresher block must be scheduled Monday from 1000 to 1200.
